pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 11.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.3: Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do we form words from other words?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences or a group of words
2. use adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences or a group of words
   In simple words: practise until you can identify adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences or a group of words. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences
   In simple words: practise until you can use adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs.
4. Show that you can: identify adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences or a group of words

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a text on careers and identify the adverbs used,
2. Construct sentences on different careers using adverbs formed from adjectives,
3. Fill in blanks using adverbs formed from adjectives,
4. Compile a list of instructions using adverbs formed from adjectives,
5. Make a list of adverbs formed from adjectives and display them on charts and posters,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we form words from other words?
2. What are the functions of adverbs?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences or a group of words
2. use adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
